nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='midwinter arrival at Rell's Gate, the last tower town before the Deep Road goes under the mountains; the company known now, the ninth iron of Kar Duhn in the captain's pack, snow on the gatehouse and a Warden's summons in hand'>>

choices.label: Report to the Warden of the Deep Road.
Take the company into the Lamp and Ladder first.
Walk the caravan yard and see who is going down.
Go with Nyre to the Reckoning chapter house.
Ask Kettle why she has not unpacked.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='Captain Sabinne Orr's commission: Sixteen Mile Tower has sent no lamp report for five weeks, the couriers are still running, and she wants the tower's road-book brought out'>>

choices.label: Ask what her patrols found at Sixteen Mile.
Press her for terms worth the walk.
Take the commission as offered.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='Orr's account: one patrol turned back at the Marchgate, the second lost a man who would not stop counting, and the Marchgate itself was found unbarred from the inside'>>

choices.label: Press her for better terms now that you know.
Take it as offered; the road will not improve.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='Orr has no coin and says so; what she has is the Deep Road oath, which makes the company Warden-sworn on her road and answerable on it'>>

choices.label: Swear the oath and take her authority.
Keep your hands free and take the coin instead.
Refuse the road entirely and winter south.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=45 beats='the oath sworn on the road-stone in front of the whole watch, the company written into the Deep Road roll, Dellach's face when the words land'>>

choices.label: Go and gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the commission sealed, and Orr's condition given quietly: the road-book above everything, because the lamp hours in it are the only reason anybody walks that road alive'>>

choices.label: Ask her for a guide who knows the hours.
Ask to read the tower's last report.
Go and gather your company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=50 beats='Ossa Vend, a lamp-lighter's daughter of nineteen who has walked the Lamp Road twice a week since she was twelve and wants a half share and her mother's debts cleared'>>

choices.label: Take her on and clear the debts.
Refuse; Vurma can read a dwarf road well enough.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=45 beats='Ossa hired, her mother paid off in front of witnesses, and the girl carrying her own lamp-pole because she will not have anybody else carry it'>>

choices.label: Gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='the tower's last report and, folded inside it, the route charts: eleven lamp stations, the hours each is lit, and a pencil note in the tower captain's hand that the hours have changed'>>

choices.label: Take the charts and gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the Lamp and Ladder, half dwarf and half Warden and entirely underground, where a road-mason is drinking through what he saw at the ninth station and the Sable Guild has a table by the flue'>>

choices.label: Buy the room a round and listen.
Corner the road-mason about the ninth station.
Step in before the Sable Guild starts on Dellach.
Take the company to the bunkroom; sleep first.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the room's version: couriers running the lower march in daylight now, two Reckoning priests gone down and not up, and a Ledger coach that came through in autumn with its curtains drawn'>>

choices.label: Follow up the ninth station story.
That is enough for one night.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the road-mason sober enough to be exact: at the ninth station the lamps are lit an hour early and the count runs backwards, and he walked out over the shoulder in snow rather than pass it'>>

choices.label: Pay him for the whole account.
Write it off as drink and altitude.
Have him take you up to the shoulder tonight to see it.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the rest of it: his mate went on down the Lamp Road to argue about the hours, and his kit came back up on a courier's barrow eight days later with the tools still wrapped'>>

choices.label: Let him be and gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='a Sable Guild delver with an opinion about surface companies on dwarf roads, delivered at length in two languages, with Dellach already setting his cup down'>>

choices.label: Let Dellach answer it with his hands.
Buy the table a round and end it.
Draw steel in a Warden gatehouse.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='two exchanges, a broken bench, a delver sitting down hard, and the Guild's own foreman calling it fair in front of the room'>>

choices.label: Get the company to the bunkroom.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='a round bought, the delver's grievance heard out in full, and grudging directions to the drift entrance thrown in at the end of it'>>

choices.label: Take the bunkroom and the quiet night.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=45 beats='a night in a dwarf bunkroom cut into rock, warm from the flue, with the company sleeping properly for the first time since Gallowmere'>>

choices.label: Gather the company at the bell.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the caravan yard under snow, one Sable Guild train loading for the lower march, a Rooks banner over the covered bay, and a dwarf sitting on her own kit with no company at all'>>

choices.label: Talk to the dwarf sitting alone.
Hire the two road-porters looking for a half share.
Cross to the Rooks banner.
Hire nobody; five is enough to feed.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='Vurma Kell, pathfinder, put out of the Sable Guild for filing a report about the ninth station that her own foreman burned, and carrying the copy she made of it'>>

choices.label: Take her on at a full share.
Offer her a half share and the copy.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='a full share agreed, the burned report's copy handed over unasked, and Ilsabet and Vurma arguing about dwarf orthography inside ten minutes and enjoying it'>>

choices.label: Gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='a half share taken flatly, the copy kept in her own coat, and a dwarf who will do exactly what she is paid for and not one yard further'>>

choices.label: Gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the road-porters, Halt and Weem, cheap and willing, who have carried for Guild trains as far as the fourth station and never once past it'>>

choices.label: Gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=50 beats='Vasse Corrow under the covered bay with a Warden charter of her own now, bought with what she learned about Kar Duhn, offering to take the Sixteen Mile contract off your hands as a courtesy'>>

choices.label: Refuse, and drink long enough to learn what she knows.
Sell her the contract and winter in comfort.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='Corrow's account of her own autumn: eleven people down the Lamp Road, nine back, and a scout who came out of the drift counting in dwarf and died of it in a Reckoning bed'>>

choices.label: Leave her the bay and gather your company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the Reckoning chapter house cut into the gatehouse rock, Prior Enna Vask presiding, and on the duty board a name Nyre has not spoken since Gallowmere: Ferrin Ostwyn, her brother, posted down the road in autumn'>>

choices.label: Have Nyre read the chapter's road account.
Draw kit and credit against the commission.
Hear the offer Vask would rather make.
Leave; this is Reckoning business.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='the chapter's road account in Nyre's flat voice: nine deliveries requisitioned down the Deep Road in nine months, every one signed by her brother, and the lamp hours copied out beside them'>>

choices.label: Take the copy and gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='credit spent properly: pitch, oil, dwarf candles, crampons, a second reservoir lamp, and a coil of wire rope that Vurma insists on and will not explain'>>

choices.label: Load out and gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=50 beats='Vask's better offer, made kindly: leave the tower alone, bring the Reckoning her brother's own papers, and the chapter will carry the company's names and debts for nine years'>>

choices.label: Sign what Vask is actually offering.
Refuse, and notice that she said nine.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='Kettle in the gatehouse arch with her pack still roped, refusing to unpack, because she has been under one mountain already this year and the Deep Road is nine hundred miles of it'>>

choices.label: Press her, gently, until she says the rest.
Let her keep it; she has earned one silence.
Tell Orr the company's scout will not go down.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='what she says: the count she learned at eleven is the same count the couriers are using on this road, in the same cadence, and she has been hearing it through the floor since you arrived'>>

choices.label: Ask her to give you the cadence.
That is enough for tonight.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='Kettle setting the cadence out on the table with three cups and a knife, the way the crews did it, so that everybody in the company can recognise it in the dark'>>

choices.label: Sit with that a while, then gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='Orr informed that the company's scout is unfit for the road, a substitute offered from her own watch, and a note made in a Warden roll about a captain who reports'>>

choices.label: Gather the company.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the last hour in Rell's Gate: kit checked, the gate lamps lit for the ninth hour, and the mouth of the Deep Road standing open in the rock like a held breath'>>

choices.label: Go down at the bell, light kit, good order.
Go down tonight, ahead of the Guild train.
Spend the advance properly before you move.
Give the commission back and winter here.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=45 beats='out at the bell with the Guild train's dust ahead of you, the road-lamps burning at their proper hours, and eight miles of good dwarf paving underfoot'>>

choices.label: Take the first junction.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='a night start to steal a march on the Guild train, six miles in the dark on unlit paving, and the company arriving at the junction cold, blind and already spent'>>

choices.label: Take the first junction.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=50 beats='the advance on a Warden table and one morning to spend it: Nyre wants a barrow, salt and lamp oil, Vurma wants a second wire line and a moor-iron pick'>>

choices.label: Barrow, salt, oil and rope.
Wire line and a moor-iron pick.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=45 beats='a hand-barrow, four stone of salt, two casks of oil and a spare reservoir, which is the most valuable load on the road and the slowest'>>

choices.label: Take the first junction.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=45 beats='a moor-iron pick and forty feet of wire line, cold in the hand and worth the weight if the drift is as bad as the Guild says'>>

choices.label: Take the first junction.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the first junction of the Deep Road, eight miles under the mountain's shoulder: the Lamp Road going on straight and lit, the surface stair going up over the shoulder in snow, and the old drift going down and west into unlit dwarf work'>>

choices.label: Stay on the lit Lamp Road.
Go up over the shoulder and rejoin below.
Take the old drift and go under it all.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=failure words=50 beats='the ride south from Rell's Gate with the oath unsworn, the tower left unreported, and Corrow's chartered company going down the Lamp Road in your place inside a week'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=60 beats='up the shoulder at night behind a drunk mason to look down at the ninth station, and the lamps below lit an hour early, and the count coming up the snow toward the two of you in the wrong direction'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=55 beats='steel drawn in a Warden gatehouse and the company in the gate cells by midnight, the commission struck and passed to the Rooks, and Orr reading the forfeiture through the bars without raising her voice'>>
<<FILL role=failure words=50 beats='the Sixteen Mile contract sold to Corrow for eighty crowns in a covered bay, and a company that winters warm and is finished as a company by spring'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=55 beats='Vask's ink dry on nine years of the company's names, the tower left alone as agreed, and Nyre walking out of her own chapter house because she has read the clause about her brother and you have not'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=50 beats='the commission handed back over a Warden table with an honest reason and no argument, and a winter in Rell's Gate listening to couriers pass under the floor at the ninth hour every ninth night'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the Lamp Road proper, dwarf paving nine feet wide under a barrel roof, with a lamp station every mile and every station lit two hours before the charts say it should be'>>

choices.label: Keep to the crown of the road.
Drop into the drainage gallery alongside it.
Stop at the fourth station where a courier's barrow is standing.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the crown of the road, which runs straight for four miles and can be seen along its whole length by anything standing at either end of it'>>

choices.label: Press on to the cistern dip.
Get down into the drainage gallery out of the sightline.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the drainage gallery beside the paving, four feet high and running with spring water, which hides the company and costs it every yard in stooped backs and wet knees'>>

choices.label: Climb out at the cistern dip.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the fourth station: a courier's barrow parked neatly, a Warden's shield hung on the lamp bracket with the paint scraped off, and a tally of nine strokes cut into the post with the ninth struck through'>>

choices.label: Cut the tally out of the post for Ilsabet.
Leave it; the barrow is not your business.
Camp here at the station where it is dry and warm.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the tally cut free and read: dwarf work, recent, and matching the mark from the Barrow Moor gibbet stroke for stroke, which means one hand keeps both counts'>>

choices.label: Pocket it and go on to the cistern.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the cistern dip, where a spring has come through the roof and filled forty feet of the road to chest height, with the lamps on both sides of it still burning under the water line'>>

choices.label: Rope a line and wade it.
Go round by the maintenance crawl and lose an hour.
Have Ilsabet crust the surface hard enough to cross.
Cross dry along the lamp brackets.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=50 beats='chest-deep in spring water at a temperature that stops argument, the rope line taut, Ossa holding her lamp-pole above her head with both arms the whole way'>>

choices.label: Keep the line taut and cross one at a time.
Let go and swim the last twenty feet.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='an hour lost in the maintenance crawl, dry to the knee, and at the crawl's far grating the first sight of the Marchgate two miles on, with all nine of its lamps lit'>>

choices.label: Rejoin the road and make camp.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='salt and glass and Ilsabet's working voice, and forty feet of cistern crusting over hard enough to bear weight for about two minutes, which is enough if nobody stops'>>

choices.label: Give her a minute, then make camp.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the surface stair up over the mountain's shoulder in a whiteout, cut for dwarves and drifted over, with cornices on the left hand and nothing whatever on the right'>>

choices.label: Rope up and take it slowly.
Push the pace and get over before dark.
Follow the beaten sledge trail somebody else cut.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the slow way, roped in line with Vurma reading the snow and Ossa's pole probing every step of the drift, six hours to cover two miles and nobody lost'>>

choices.label: Drop off the shoulder at the old workings.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the fast way, which works until Weem puts a leg through a snow bridge over a drainage shaft and hangs there on his own rope harness for eleven minutes'>>

choices.label: Slow down; the shoulder made its point.
Keep the pace and let the shoulder try again.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='a sledge trail beaten flat through the drift, days old, wide as a door, with small hard bootprints on both flanks of it and a smell of lamp oil in the snow'>>

choices.label: Follow it and see what was hauled.
Get off it and back into open snow.
Set an ambush on the trail and wait.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the sledge cache at the trail's end: Warden kit sorted by type under a snow tarp, boots in one pile and belts in another, four sledges empty and one still loaded and roped'>>

choices.label: Take the Warden signet and the dispatch tube.
Bury what can be buried and let Nyre say the words.
Back off now; the Skree are still on the shoulder.
Follow the small bootprints back to their camp.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='a Warden signet and a dispatch tube out of the pile, the tube still sealed, and the seal on it a Reckoning seal rather than a Warden one'>>

choices.label: Get off the trail and go to ground.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='an hour of digging graves in frozen ground with a moor-iron pick, Nyre's words said properly over nine Wardens, Dellach facing uphill throughout'>>

choices.label: Move before the light goes.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='two hours lying in snow and then nine minutes of violence: five Skree dead in the trail, one of them wearing Warden boots and a bone tally-ring of nine strokes at the throat'>>

choices.label: Take the tally-ring and get off the trail.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the old workings under the shoulder, and in a drift-filled adit a body frozen upright: hands bound at the wrist, a strip of iron laid in the open mouth, and snow undisturbed above it for a season'>>

choices.label: Have Ilsabet read the iron in the mouth.
Take the iron and go.
Cover the face and leave the man his iron.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='Ilsabet reading the strip by lamp: dwarf-cut, a pay-tally, one of nine, and the rank on it the ninth hand, cut with a die she says was struck within the year'>>

choices.label: Make camp while there is light.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the old drift, unlit and unmaintained, going down and west under everything, its mouth walled to half height by a survey crew that then took its own wall down again'>>

choices.label: Walk the open drift where the survey pillars stand.
Take the covered gallery where the roof holds.
Back out and rejoin the Lamp Road at the cistern.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the open drift with survey pillars every hundred feet, nine notches cut into the third pillar, and a lamp niche beside it holding a clay lamp with oil in it that has not gummed'>>

choices.label: Take the oil; a full reservoir is a full reservoir.
Leave the niche exactly as you found it.
Duck into the covered gallery instead.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the lamp decanted, good clean oil, and Vurma saying what everybody has worked out already: somebody services this drift, on a schedule, and will notice a light reservoir before they notice anything else'>>

choices.label: Push on to the camp ground.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the covered gallery, dry and echoing badly, its roof holding except at the far end where a fall has closed the way, and something in the rubble of the fall shifting once while you look at it'>>

choices.label: Dig through the fall.
Take the crawl on the left of it.
Back out and take the open drift's lamp niche instead.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='an hour of moving stone by hand, Dellach and Halt at the face, until the fall gives up a shoulder-width gap that breathes out air smelling of lamp oil and old meat'>>

choices.label: Take the gap while the fall is quiet.
Widen it properly first; do it once, do it right.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='sixty feet of crawl and then a chamber: nine lamp niches burnt dry, nine hooks, and beneath them a Reckoning courier sitting in a good coat with a chapter seal still at the collar'>>

choices.label: Take the chapter seal off the body.
Back out; nine dead lamps is a message and you have read it.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='Prior Vask's own chapter seal in your hand, and in the dead courier's satchel nine requisition slips signed by Ferrin Ostwyn, the last of them dated eleven days ago'>>

choices.label: Take it and get out into moving air.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the last camp at the eleventh station, two miles short of the Marchgate, with nine lamps burning ahead of you in the dark and the company's mood the specific quiet of people who have stopped asking whether the charts are wrong'>>

choices.label: Cold camp, full watch, no lamps.
Lamps, hot food and a short watch; they need it.
Send Kettle forward to look at the Marchgate.
Break camp and be at the gate before the hour.
Call it. The road has beaten better companies.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='a cold camp with the lamps out, and at the third hour a courier file goes past on the paving below the station: nine lamps, unhurried, and somebody at the head of it counting in a language with far too many numbers'>>

choices.label: Let it pass and log the hour.
Follow it at distance.
Leave the porters on watch and get an hour's sleep.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='one lamp, hot food, dry socks and ninety minutes of sleep each in a dwarf station with a working flue, and at the end of it something standing at the edge of the lamplight that does not approach and does not leave'>>

choices.label: Stand to and challenge it.
Douse the lamp and lie flat until it goes.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the challenge given in the Warden form three times, and the shape at the edge of the light answering on the third with a number instead of a name, and then waiting to see whether anybody here knows the next one'>>

choices.label: Say nothing more; hold and let it go.
Answer it. Give it the next number.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='Kettle back at the second hour with a bad colour: the Marchgate stands unbarred, its nine lamps are trimmed, a Warden's shield is nailed to the gate post as a notice, and the snow inside the arch has boot prints going in and none coming out'>>

choices.label: Walk up to the gate at the hour and go in.
Wait for the next file and go in behind it.
Send her in alone to open the way for the rest.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='the file comes through at the third hour and the company follows it in at forty paces, moving on the lamp-count off the charts, arriving at the Marchgate with the leaf still swinging'>>

choices.label: Go in.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='following nine lamps down a dwarf road at forty paces, close enough to hear the count and to hear one member of the file who is not walking under his own management, and the count is not rising, it is going round'>>

choices.label: Keep silent and follow to the gate.
Take the count up with them and walk in as one of nine.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='the company falling into the file and taking the count, Kettle steady on numbers she learned at eleven, and eleven minutes of that rhythm teaching you the hours, the stations, and what the file is hauling'>>

choices.label: Break off at the gate before the count comes round.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='camp struck at midnight and the last two miles walked on unlit paving out of the captain's impatience, the company arriving at the Marchgate grey and short-tempered with an hour still to wait'>>

choices.label: Look at what you came for.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='the Marchgate of Sixteen Mile: a dwarf arch across the whole road with a Warden tower cut into the rock above it, its lintel carved with a door of nine irons, a scraped shield nailed to the post, nine lamps burning, and the gate leaf standing unbarred and open a hand's width exactly as Orr's patrol reported'>>

choices.label: Go in by the open leaf.
Send Kettle up the ventilation shaft and follow.
Have Ilsabet break the mason's postern in the tower.
Sit on the gate and watch it for a full day first.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='a day spent watching a gate: at the ninth hour two men in Warden cloaks that do not fit them come out, take down three lamps, and carry them back in, and neither of them uses his hands on the leaf'>>

choices.label: Enough watching. Go in by the leaf.
Go up the ventilation shaft where nobody counts.
Take the mason's postern.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='a dry warm camp at the fourth station, and at the third hour the file arrives and stops, and a voice begins a count that includes the sleepers by name in the order they lay down, with the captain ninth'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=55 beats='the lamp brackets taken as a dry route across the cistern, and the fourth bracket coming out of nine-hundred-year-old mortar with two of the company hanging from it over water that is deeper than the lamps suggested'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=50 beats='the rope let go in spring water cold enough to stop thought, and the cistern's overflow going somewhere the dwarves cut on purpose, and the road going on being exactly as quiet as before'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=60 beats='the pace kept and the shoulder's second attempt succeeding: a cornice giving way with three of the company on it, the barrow gone, and Sixteen Mile still two miles off in a whiteout nobody walks out of'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='the small bootprints followed home to a Skree warren of two hundred under the shoulder, and the company taken alive because alive is what the warren is paid to deliver, and five more marks entered in a tally kept for somebody down the road'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the last quarter mile to the Marchgate in the open on dwarf paving, the arch ahead, the Warden's shield on its post catching the lamplight, nine lamps on nine brackets and boot prints going in'>>

choices.label: Walk up the middle of the road in good order.
Come at it along the drainage gallery instead.
Send the barrow up the paving ahead of you and watch.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=failure words=60 beats='the barrow sent up the paving ahead of the company as an experiment, which rolls to the arch, stops, stands for nine seconds, and then goes in through a gap it cannot fit through, with the salt and the oil still on it'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the gate leaf from a foot away, dwarf bronze on iron, standing open a hand's width, with warm air coming out of the tunnel behind it and the edge of the gap worn smooth at shoulder height by traffic'>>

choices.label: Go through the gap one at a time.
Lever the leaf wider with the pick.
Take the Warden's shield off the post first.
Knock, and see who keeps the gate.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='sideways through a hand's width of bronze with packs passed after, and the leaf moving a finger's width inward while Halt is still in it, on no draught at all'>>

choices.label: Get everyone through and form up inside.

Take the Warden's shield off the post before you go in.

Wait the full ten minutes as agreed.

Burn the stores with the lamp oil.

Take the iron off the nearest one's belt on the way past.

Break it with the pick and go in loud.
Read the tally beside it first.

Break it; whoever keeps that count already knows.

choices.label: Go in.

choices.label: Take him alive.
Put him down quietly and move.
Challenge whoever is behind that lamp.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the tower guardroom: a road-scale on its plinth, nine relay chests along the wall all open and empty, a floor mosaic of a door held shut by nine hands, and three ways on, the barracks arch, the road office, and a gallery smelling of fresh lamp oil'>>

choices.label: Clear the barracks arch first.
Go to the road office; that is the contract.
Follow the smell of fresh oil.
Read the mosaic on the floor properly.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the tower barracks, twenty bunks made up to inspection standard with kit stowed and boots paired, and the far third of the room walled off floor to ceiling with a barricade of shields and bunk timber built from this side'>>

choices.label: Take the barricade apart.
Search the sergeant's chest.
Sleep here in shifts; the company is spent.
Strip the kit and the pay chest and go back up the road rich.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the barricade opened enough to see: nine Wardens seated shoulder to shoulder along the wall behind it, drained to paper, hands folded, boots off and paired beside each of them, and the third from the left slowly turning its head'>>

choices.label: Put it down properly and quickly.
Ask it a question.
Wall it back up and walk away.
Cut it free and carry it up the road for Orr to see.

choices.label: Go through the sergeant's chest.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the question asked and answered in numbers, patiently, the way a clerk answers a query: eight, a pause, eight again, and when Nyre asks who the ninth is, the head turns further and looks straight at the company'>>

choices.label: Stop there. Put it down and close the wall.
Ask it the ninth question.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the sergeant's chest, unlocked because there was nothing left worth locking: a duty roster with nine names struck out in one ink, an unmarked relay key-iron blank, and a flask of dwarf spirit with two fingers gone'>>

choices.label: Take the roster.
Take the blank iron.
Share the spirit out; they have earned two fingers each.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='the roster read walking: nine names struck out on nine consecutive days, the last of them the tower captain's own, and against each name in the margin the dwarf word for tendered'>>

choices.label: Take the road office passage.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='an unmarked relay iron, the same gauge as the ones the mosaic shows, blank where the tally should be cut, which Ilsabet wraps in salt-cloth and stows in her own pack without explaining'>>

choices.label: Take the road office passage.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=50 beats='two fingers of dwarf spirit each, which is not much and turns out to be exactly enough, and the whole company's hands come back to them inside ten minutes'>>

choices.label: Take the road office passage.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the road office: a desk the length of the room, nine tally boards ranged along the wall, the road-book open at its last page under a lamp still burning, and in the ninth relay chest's lock a key-iron standing where a hand let go of it'>>

Take the road-book; Orr wants the road-book.
Take the relay iron out of the lock.
Search the clerk's cubby behind the desk.

choices.label: Take the iron out of the lock and get out.
Leave it all where it lies and search the cubby.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=55 beats='the road-book off the desk into Nyre's satchel, four pounds of Warden record and the whole second half of your commission, and the lamp above it guttering out as it comes away'>>

choices.label: Take the iron from the lock as well.
Leave the iron; the road-book is what was asked for.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the relay key-iron drawn out of the lock, cold as well-water and heavier than its size argues for, and every lamp in the tower dipping together the moment it clears the wards while something far below starts its count again from one'>>

Put it straight back in the lock and take only paper.
Pocket it and search the clerk's cubby.
Carry it in your mouth, the way the frozen man carried his.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='salt-cloth, oilcloth, the middle of the pack alongside Kar Duhn's iron, and the pressure behind everybody's eyes stopping at once, which tells Ilsabet what she suspected: it was never the iron, it was being noticed through it'>>

choices.label: Search the clerk's cubby and get out.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the clerk's cubby behind the desk: a cot slept in for months, a private tally scratched into the plaster in nines, a jar of clean water, and a hole broken through the wall at floor level breathing warm air'>>

Put a lamp down the hole and look.
Leave it; read the schedule board and take the stair.
Go down the hole now, while it is quiet.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='the plaster tally, which is not days but deliveries, kept in nines for five weeks by a steady hand, with the hours of each written beside it, and in the last group eight strokes and then, instead of a ninth, the word mine'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='a lamp lowered on a bootlace: eleven feet of broken wall, then a floor, and on the floor a set of small neat bootprints going round and round in a circle several hundred times without leaving it'>>

choices.label: Pull the lamp up and go by the schedule board.
Reach down and take up what is lying by the bootprints.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the lamp gallery: nine niches with nine lamps trimmed and full, an oil store stacked to the roof, a schedule board in chalk, and asleep on the bench beneath it a Reckoning novice with a tally-book rising and falling on his chest'>>

choices.label: Take him alive and ask him everything.
Wake him politely and talk terms.
Kill him and take the book.
Read the board and leave him sleeping.
Put a light in the oil store on your way past.

Ask only what you need: the safe way down.
Promise to take him out with you when you go.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='the route only, given gratefully: the relay stair behind the ninth niche, two landings where nobody stops, and the one hour of the day when the stair belongs to somebody else and must be left alone'>>

choices.label: Read the schedule board.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=60 beats='a promise made out loud in front of witnesses and written in Nyre's book, and the boy giving up the hours, the stations, the cadence and a warning about the ninth hour like a man confessing to murder'>>

choices.label: Read the schedule board together.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the novice woken civilly and turning out to be a negotiator: he will give the stair and the hours if the company carries one sealed parcel up the road, unopened, and leaves it at the Reckoning chapter house'>>

Break faith; bind him and ask properly.
Take his other offer: one hour in the file, and safe passage.

Put on his habit and carry his lamp.

choices.label: Read the schedule board.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the schedule board in chalk: nine niches, nine hours, lamps trimmed on the hour, the ninth hour ringed twice with four words beside it in a careful hand, do not be on the stair, and behind the ninth niche the relay stair going down'>>

Wait for the ninth hour and go down behind the file.

Wait to see what comes up to relight them.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='the relay stair behind the ninth niche, nine feet wide and cut for traffic, going down in long flights into the sunless march itself: warm moving air, water somewhere beneath it, and a smell like a forge left to go out slowly'>>

Go down dark, one hand on the wall.
Rope the stair and send Kettle a flight ahead.
Turn around. Take what you have and get out.

choices.label: Let him make his offer, then.
Leave him talking and go to the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the offer, made plainly and without threat: Ferrin is forty-one and will not last another winter of it, the office falls vacant on his death, and for one of the five, named by the captain today, he will give up the iron, the road-book, the tower's arrears and nine more years of the road's peace'>>

choices.label: Refuse, and go for the door.
Counter: the company will settle this another way.
Accept, and name one of them.
Accept, and name yourself.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='the counter-offer put to him straight: nine irons seated and no hand at all keeping any count afterwards, and Ferrin's face doing something complicated, because his own order taught him that no debt simply ends and he has spent four years proving it'>>

choices.label: Go to the door with his blessing, such as it is.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='Ferrin does not defend himself, and does not need to, because the chapel does it: nine benches worth of dust standing up in the shapes of the people who sat on them, and Nyre's voice going up for the first time in two books'>>

choices.label: Finish him before the benches close.
Break off and run for the door.
Take him hostage and walk him to the door.
Stand and fight the chapel.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='Ferrin Ostwyn dead at his own desk in the time it takes to say a number, his sister standing over him, and the count stopping everywhere in the march at once, and eight irons audibly taking a load they were never asked to take alone'>>

choices.label: Run for the door now, while the silence lasts.
Take his tally-book and his ring off the desk.
Wait and see what the count does without a keeper.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='Ferrin's tally-book and the ninth hand's ring off a dead man's desk, the book eleven hundred pages in nine hands with the last four months in a hand Nyre has known all her life, and the ring warm and sized for whoever lifts it'>>

choices.label: Take both and go to the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the wheel-house under the pay-station: a dwarf pump the size of a barn with its wheel turning in a race of black water, three of its nine paddles hacked away, and a Skree crew working on the fourth with axes and no hurry at all'>>

choices.label: Kill the crew and mend the paddles.
Jam the wheel and flood the lower march yourselves.
Cross the wheel-race to the door gallery.
Ride the wheel down and see what it drains into.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='a short brutal fight in a loud room and then an hour of carpentry, Dellach and Vurma holding a paddle while Ilsabet lashes it, the race dropping a hand's width, and the lower march staying dry a while longer'>>

choices.label: Leave it running and go to the door.
Stay and keep it running; somebody has to.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the wheel jammed with a pick haft and the race backing up in minutes, water going the wrong way through nine hundred years of dwarf engineering and down into the lower hall where the crates are stacked and the file is still working'>>

choices.label: Do it and run for the door on the high side.
Do it now, while half the company is still below.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=60 beats='the wheel-race crossed on the axle housing with the wheel turning a foot behind your head, nine paddles coming round in an order you can learn, and the gap between them exactly as wide as one person who does not hesitate'>>

choices.label: Cross one at a time on the count of the paddles.
Cross together and quickly; the crew has seen you.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the breach in the march wall, and behind it the road-shrine the dwarves cut past and thought they had merely cut past: nine road-wardens seated in stone around a tenth chair that is empty, their plaques legible, their hands all pointing the same way'>>

choices.label: Read the wardens' plaques.
Close the breach with rubble and be done with it.
Go through the shrine to the door gallery.
Take the ring off the empty tenth chair.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='nine plaques read in order, and they are not names but offices: the one who counts, the one who carries, the one who signs, on to the ninth, which is the one who is owed, and all nine stone hands pointing at the shrine's inner door'>>

choices.label: Go to the door with that in your head.
Follow where all nine hands are pointing.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=60 beats='two hours of rubble and mortar dust and Dellach's shoulder against a slab, the breach closed as well as five people can close it, and everybody understanding without discussion that this is housekeeping and not a solution'>>

choices.label: Go on to the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='through the shrine's inner chamber toward the door gallery, past nine empty stone chairs and one that is occupied by something that has been sitting there since before the dwarves cut the first gallery, and that does not turn its head as you pass'>>

choices.label: Walk past it without looking and keep walking.
Look at it properly, once, so you know.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the cutting-shop where the relay irons were made: a cold forge, a tally-die bolted to its anvil, racks of blanks gone to rust, the cutting-orders still pinned to the bench, and a dwarf smith folded under the bellows with his tools laid out in order'>>

choices.label: Cut a blank into a ninth relay iron on the die.
Take the tally-die off the anvil.
Read the cutting-orders on the bench.
Light the forge; you need the heat and the light.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='three hours of cold work on a die that wants a striker and a smith, Ilsabet reading the order stroke by stroke while Dellach swings, and at the end of it a ninth relay iron that is nine parts right and one part yours'>>

choices.label: Take it and go to the door.
Cut a second one while the die is set.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=55 beats='the tally-die unbolted and wrapped, forty pounds of dwarf steel that decides what any relay iron says, which Vurma calls the only thing down here worth carrying out and Ilsabet calls the only thing down here worth burying'>>

choices.label: Carry it and go to the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=70 beats='the cutting-orders off the bench: nine irons commissioned at the founding of the road, eight cut with the holding tally and the ninth cut with a name left blank for the hand that would keep the count, and a note that the blank must never be cut twice'>>

choices.label: Take the orders and go to the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=80 beats='the second door of the Compact, at Hollowmarch under the mountains: dwarf iron in a frame of older stone, nine sockets in a ring with eight filled and warm, the ninth empty and worn bright, the metal moving very slightly outward and back on a nine-count, and behind it, patient and enormous, the thing the whole road has been feeding'>>

choices.label: Set the relay iron in its socket and lock the door.
Draw the eight irons and unmake the Compact.
Take the relay iron out of the march entirely.
Open the door a hand's width and look.
Withdraw. This is a Warden matter and an order's crime.
Knock, the way you knocked at the gate.
Walk out of the march and never speak of it again.

<<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the door gallery, the last hundred yards: nine niches with nine lamps trimmed, the air moving along the floor on a nine-count, and halfway along a pair of Warden's boots set neatly against the wall with the tags still in them'>>

choices.label: Walk it, lamps up, and do not stop.
Put out your own lamps and walk it in the dark.
Take the tags out of the boots; somebody's family gets a name.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=failure words=60 beats='two Warden tags lifted out of a pair of boots set down neatly by their owner in a place where nothing is neat by accident, and the nine lamps of the gallery going out in order from the far end, and the boots being, on reflection, a place setting'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=80 beats='the relay iron set into the ninth socket, which takes it the way a lock takes its key, and the door's breathing stopping mid-count: eight irons and a ninth, all nine warm, the frame taking the load, and nothing behind it moving for the first time in four months'>>

choices.label: Break the tally-die so no tenth iron can ever be cut.
Take the keeper's ring; a count still needs a hand.
Get everyone up the stair while it is quiet.
Drive it in crooked so the socket jams forever.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='the tally-die carried back to the cutting-shop and broken across its own anvil in four strokes, dwarf steel going in a way dwarf steel should not go, and Vurma on her knees afterwards checking the floor for fragments twice'>>

choices.label: Go up the stair.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the ninth hand's ring on the desk beside Ferrin's book, warm and exactly sized, and the arithmetic laid out plainly: nine irons hold the lid without a keeper only until something tests it, and a count kept honestly by somebody who hates the work is the difference'>>

choices.label: Put it on. Somebody has to keep the count.
Leave it on the desk. Nobody in this company signs that.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=70 beats='the ring on, and the count arriving in the back of the skull like a schedule read aloud by a clerk, not a voice and not a compulsion but an obligation with dates in it, and a captain standing in a courier chapel understanding the shape of the rest of a life'>>

choices.label: Take the company up the stair.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='the decision to unmake the Compact at the second door: eight irons in eight warm sockets, nine hundred years of instalments paid by people never consulted, and five people standing in front of the only working arrangement anybody has managed with what is on the other side'>>

choices.label: Draw one iron and watch what the door does.
Draw all eight at once and run.
Draw them, then wedge the ring of sockets with the ninth.
Change your mind and seat the ninth instead.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='one iron out and the door leans a quarter inch outward; two, and the frame's stone begins to sweat; three, and the door speaks in the road-paymaster's voice and asks with real courtesy whether the company has come to settle the account or to increase it'>>

choices.label: Re-seat all three and step back from it.
Keep drawing. Finish what you started.
Ask it what it is owed.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='three irons back into three sockets by hands that are not steady, the door settling with the sound of a held breath let out slowly, and the paymaster's voice thanking the company by name, all five names, pronounced correctly'>>

choices.label: Get out of the march.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the relay iron driven crosswise through the socket ring rather than into it, dwarf iron biting dwarf iron until the whole ring is one piece that no hand can draw and no keeper can count: crude, permanent, and in nobody's orders'>>

choices.label: Leave it wedged and go up the stair.
Test it first; put your weight on the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='a hand's width of the second door held open on the pick haft with Dellach's boot braced against the frame, warm air coming out in a rhythm that is not wind, and light on the other side that is not lamplight and has no source'>>

choices.label: Look through it.
Put a lamp through first and watch what happens to it.
Shut it again without looking. Nobody needs to know.
Speak through the gap.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=75 beats='what is behind the second door: not a beast in a lair but a hall the size of the mountain with something at the far end too large to resolve, and standing in rows in front of it in Warden cloaks and Reckoning habits and dwarf mail, four thousand people, counting'>>

choices.label: Shut it and seat the relay iron.
Shut it and get out of the march.
Go in for them. Somebody has to.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='a lit lamp set through the gap on a rope and lowered a foot, burning steadily for four seconds, then going out from the wick downward, then coming back up the rope relit by nobody at all with the flame a better colour than before'>>

choices.label: Look through it now that you have to know.
Reach through and take the lamp back.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the door eased shut on nothing seen, the haft withdrawn, the count resuming where it left off, and five people in a dwarf gallery deciding together not to know something each of them will privately want to know for the rest of their lives'>>

choices.label: Go up the stair.
Withdraw properly and make it a Warden matter.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='the arithmetic from the other side: eight irons hold the lid as long as nobody tests it, but the ninth is the count, and a count that cannot be kept is a debt that cannot be collected, and Kar Duhn's ninth iron is already in your pack next to this one'>>

choices.label: Wrap it deep and carry it out of the march.
Seat it after all; a shut door is worth more than leverage.
Carry it out and sink it in the cistern on the way up.
Carry it in the open and let them come and ask for it.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=70 beats='salt-cloth, oilcloth, the middle of the pack beside the first one, Ilsabet's chalk across the flap in two directions, and the whole march's attention settling on five people who now hold two of the nine counts in one bag'>>

choices.label: Up the stair, and quickly.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the honest option said out loud in front of the second door by Nyre, who has been assembling it since the chapel: this is nine hundred years old, it is a Warden matter and a crime by her own order, and five people with one commission do not get to be the hinge of it'>>

choices.label: Out the way you came in, and no souvenirs.
Out, but take the road-book from the office.
Out, and burn the nine gate lamps behind you.
Out, and sell what you know to Corrow instead.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='back up to the road office for four pounds of Warden record that Orr will read and the Reckoning will want burnt, the lamp above the desk still lit, and the clerk's cubby behind it with its plaster tally running to the ceiling'>>

choices.label: Take the road-book and go.
Take the road-book and the clerk's tally off the plaster too.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=75 beats='four hundred steps up, and the march has changed its mind about the company: the flights are longer than they were, the stair-shrine's ninth niche is warm again, all nine lamps in the tower gallery are lit and trimmed, and the gate leaf has come to within a thumb's width of shut'>>

choices.label: Force the gate leaf with everything you have.
Go out up the ventilation shaft.
Go out by the mason's postern.
Wait for the ninth hour and walk out with the file.
Sit down on the stair. You are finished.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='five people, a pick haft, a Warden's shield as a fulcrum and eleven minutes of the worst work any of them has done, the leaf giving an inch at a time against a pressure that is not weight and is not wind and does not negotiate'>>

choices.label: Get everyone through the moment it is wide enough.
Hold it and count them through by name.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the ventilation shaft from below, forty feet of dwarf cut with half its staples missing, the cistern room behind you filling, and the lamps in the tower gallery going out one at a time from the far end toward the stair'>>

choices.label: Go up in pairs, slowly, and take the skin off your hands.
Send the strongest up first to haul the rest.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=60 beats='out by the mason's postern into a Lamp Road night, the lead seal broken behind you, and the corridor beyond lighting itself politely one niche at a time all the way back to the stair, like a house showing a guest to the door'>>

choices.label: Get out onto the paving.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the ninth hour waited out in the oil store and then the file forming on the stair below, nine lamps lifted, the count starting, and the Ninth Sword walking out of Sixteen Mile in the middle of it with the rhythm right and nobody's hands where they can be seen'>>

choices.label: Break off at the gate and get clear.
Stay in the file to the end of the count; it is only nine.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the Lamp Road at the first hour with the Marchgate behind you and Rell's Gate half a day up the paving, the company carrying whatever it decided to carry, and Nyre asking the question that has to be settled before anybody speaks to a Warden'>>

choices.label: Straight up the road to Rell's Gate.
Two days at the fourth station first; they are spent.
Put it to the company as a company. All five voices.
Go over the shoulder and away west with what you carry.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=65 beats='two days at the fourth station with a working flue and no watch to keep, Kettle sleeping eleven hours, Dellach's hands coming back, Ilsabet writing the whole account out twice in case one copy burns'>>

choices.label: Walk into Rell's Gate on the third morning.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the company council on a lamp-station bench: Dellach for the Warden and the written record, Nyre for her own order's hearing and the naming of Vask, Kettle for the west road and no names at all, Ilsabet for whichever choice keeps the fewest copies of the truth'>>

choices.label: Take it to the Warden, all five names on it.
Take it in and let the record decide it, all five names on it.
Let them argue it out and then decide for yourself.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='there is a promise to keep, made in a lamp gallery in front of witnesses and written in Nyre's book, and keeping it means going back down to Sixteen Mile for a Reckoning novice the company has just spent everything to leave behind'>>

choices.label: Go in at the postern and get him out.
Call him out from the gate and wait one hour, no more.
Go in by the gate leaf because it is faster.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=75 beats='Rell's Gate in a thaw, and everybody waiting: the Warden's tower with a lamp at the wrong hour, a Reckoning coach in the yard with southern horses, the Rooks pretending not to watch the road, and Prior Vask at the gate shrine lighting candles in nines for a brother nobody has reported dead'>>

choices.label: Report to Orr, on the record, in full.
Go to the Reckoning hearing and name Vask.
Write the report the Wardens will read in fifty years.
Go back down for the novice before anything else.
Tell Prior Vask about her brother before you tell anyone else.
Say the minimum, take the fee, and be gone by dark.
Hear Corrow's price for your silence and your charts.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='Prior Vask at the gate shrine, told in a thawing street by a captain who has rehearsed the words for two days and gets them wrong regardless, and who discovers that she has known since autumn, and has been requisitioning the deliveries herself to keep the count from falling behind'>>

choices.label: Take her with you to the Warden.
Stay with her until the candles burn out.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=75 beats='Captain Sabinne Orr reads it twice, all of it, without asking a question, then squares the pages and asks the only three that matter to her: what is shut, what is loose, and what exactly is in the company's pack'>>

choices.label: Ask for the Warden charter and a standing writ.
Hand over the relay iron with the report.
Keep both irons, and have her write to the third door.
Put Ferrin's book on the table and let her decide.
Tell her the door is shut and leave the rest out.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=75 beats='the written report, which will outlive everybody in the room: dated, signed by five hands, sealed to the Warden archive at Rell's Gate, and requiring the captain to set down in plain words what was done to the second door and by whom'>>

choices.label: Write that the company now keeps the count.
Write that the door is open and how far.
Write that three irons were drawn and reseated.
Write that the sockets are wedged and ask for masons.
Write that the company did not go through the door.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the Reckoning hearing convened in the chapter house with three priors down from the south, Vask at the end of the table taking her own minutes, and Nyre standing up as a sister of the Reckoning to say that her brother did not act alone and that the requisitions are in her prior's hand'>>

choices.label: Testify in full, everything, on the record.
Testify, and hand the order the relay iron as surety.
Withdraw the accusation for what she is offering.

<<FILL role=completion words=70 beats='the promise kept: in at the postern at dusk, the lamp gallery empty with all nine lit, and Brother Cull found asleep in the oil store where he had been hiding for two days on half a loaf, carried out over Dellach's shoulder into thawing air'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=70 beats='a short honest report that says the door is shut and stops there, the fee paid, the company thanked and released, and four people who each know that a decision was taken in a dwarf gallery to leave nine hundred years of arithmetic out of a Warden's file'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=70 beats='the relay iron handed to the Reckoning as surety and entered in its register under a number, which is the safest place on the road and the one place the Compact has always been able to reach, and a receipt worth exactly what the paper is worth'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='written into a Warden file in the captain's own hand: the door is shut, all nine irons are seated, and the count is kept by the captain of the Ninth Sword, who will be at the Marchgate every ninth night for the rest of a life that now has a schedule attached'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the truth entered in the record to the inch, the tower evacuated within the hour, Rell's Gate's own evacuation order posted by noon, and a company that did the honest thing sitting in the yard watching a road town load its carts'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='three irons drawn and reseated, written down exactly like that, a Warden clerk copying it twice, and Orr asking the question nobody in the room can answer: whether a socket that has been emptied once holds the same as a socket that never has'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='a file recording that the company reached the second door, described it accurately, touched nothing and came out, which is the most defensible sentence in the Rell's Gate archive and the one the Ninth Sword will be asked about in every station house for nine years'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='the fee paid for the road-book with no questions invited and none asked, the company out of the gatehouse before dark with the money split five ways, and an understanding never spoken aloud that Hollowmarch is now somebody else's arithmetic'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the charts, the hours, the cadence and the company's silence sold to Corrow for three hundred crowns and a promise, and a chartered company going down the Lamp Road at the thaw with fifteen people who were told the easy version'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='Rell's Gate skirted and the west road taken over the shoulder with the pack still packed, no report and no fee and no charter, and two irons travelling further from their sockets every day in the luggage of five people who have agreed not to discuss it'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='an argument on a lamp-station bench allowed to run until it stops being an argument, Kettle west that afternoon, Nyre to her order with her own account, Dellach into the tower alone with his, and the Ninth Sword ending not at a door but in a disagreement about paperwork'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='an afternoon at a gate shrine with a prior lighting candles in nines for a brother she was requisitioning deliveries for, which is the right place for a captain to be and the wrong place for this captain today, while Orr waits four hours and writes that the company did not present itself'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='the relay iron hammered in at an angle to jam the socket forever, which works, and which cracks the socket's stone collar, and a ring of nine that has held for nine hundred years discovering that it is now a ring of eight and a wound'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='eight irons pulled in under a minute and a company running for a stair four hundred steps long, which is a plan that requires the door to open slowly, and the second door sees no reason at all to be slow about it'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the fourth iron drawn while the paymaster's voice is still being courteous, and then the fifth, after which no further decisions are required of anybody in the gallery, because the arrangement has concluded and the accounts are being settled in the order they were opened'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the question asked through three empty sockets and answered in full, itemised, with dates and running totals, and the figure being one that the company is standing inside of, and the door explaining without heat that a debt does not require the consent of the instalment'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='a shoulder put against a wedged door to see whether the work holds, which it does entirely, right up until the thing on the other side puts its own weight against the same door in the same second out of what can only be called curiosity'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='one sentence spoken through a hand's width of open door, in common speech, politely, and the reply arriving not as sound but as arithmetic: the company counted, priced, scheduled and entered against an instalment recorded as falling due immediately'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the door pushed wide and five people walking into a hall the size of a mountain to bring out four thousand who are standing in rows counting, which is the most defensible decision anybody makes in this story, and which adds five to the rows and changes nothing else'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='an arm through the gap to take back a lamp relit by nobody, and the lamp handed over properly into the hand that reached for it by something that has been waiting nine hundred years for a transaction it did not have to begin itself'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the relay iron sunk in the cistern dip on the way up, which solves the problem for one winter, until the spring load drops the water line and a Guild train's water detail finds a strip of warm metal on the bottom and sells it at Rell's Gate for two coppers'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the relay iron carried openly up the Lamp Road as an invitation, on the theory that whatever wants it must come out into lamplight and negotiate, and the discovery on the second night that it does not have to come out at all and never has'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='nine lamps smashed and burning in the Marchgate arch as a gesture on the way out, and the road's answer arriving not that night but nine nights later at Rell's Gate, in a file that comes up the paving at the third hour with its own lamps and its own list'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='everything the company learned under the mountain sold to Vasse Corrow in a thawing yard for good coin and no receipt, the commission returned unfulfilled, and a chartered banner going down the Lamp Road a week later with people who were told the easy version'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the plaster tally chiselled off the cubby wall because it is evidence and evidence wins arguments with Wardens, which takes eleven minutes, which is about eight minutes longer than the clerk's own arrangement allowed for with whatever comes to read his wall on the hour'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='a captain sitting down on the two hundredth step because the legs have finished arguing, a company that will not leave without its captain, and a stair that has been getting longer all evening and is in no hurry whatsoever'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the gate leaf held on a shield fulcrum while five names are called through it in order, which is exactly what the shield's dead owner scratched a warning about on its inside face, and the fifth name answered from behind the leaf in the captain's own voice'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='the strongest sent up the shaft first to haul the rest, which puts one set of hands at the top and four sets of boots on staples that are half missing, and the fourth staple from the top has been waiting all day for exactly this weight'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the file stayed with to the end of the count because it is only nine and the rhythm is easy and the company is nearly out, and the ninth number arriving on the paving in open air with the Lamp Road visible and the count starting again from one without a gap'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='the gate leaf taken because it is faster and the novice needs an hour, and the leaf being wide enough for one and then not wide enough for anybody, and a company keeping its promise as far as the threshold and no further'>>

<<FILL role=failure words=70 beats='Kettle's report proving accurate in every particular, the Rooks in the yard and a Reckoning coach at the chapter house and eleven Warden cloaks that do not fit their men, and the company walking into Rell's Gate anyway because there is nowhere else on this road to walk'>>

ending.title: Who Was Waiting at the Gate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the last mile of Lamp Road into Rell's Gate in a thaw, the gatehouse ahead, the tower lamp burning at an hour that means somebody is waiting up, and a Reckoning coach standing in the yard with its curtains drawn and its driver still on the box'>>

choices.label: Walk in openly, up the middle, in your own colours.
Send Kettle ahead to see who is waiting at the gate.
Go round to the chapter house's back door and be quiet.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='Kettle back from the gate inside eleven minutes with a list, delivered flat and in order: the Rooks in the yard doing nothing badly, a Reckoning clerk taking names at the chapter door, and eleven Warden cloaks on the gate that do not fit the men inside them'>>

choices.label: Walk in anyway; there is nowhere else to walk.
Wait for full dark and go in over the gate wall.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the Warden's anteroom at Rell's Gate, wet cloaks steaming on the pegs, the report copied fair in Ilsabet's hand and read through once more while a clerk pretends not to watch a pack that has not left the captain's shoulder since Hollowmarch'>>

choices.label: Go in and give it to Orr straight.
Ask for the Reckoning prior to be present when you speak.
Leave the fair copy with the clerk and walk out of town.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=failure words=65 beats='a fair copy of everything left on a clerk's desk with five names on it and no witness to the handing over, read by Orr eleven days later, by which time the Reckoning coach has been back to the chapter house twice and left again'>>
